46365-our-schools-in-war-time-and-after.title: Our Schools In War Time--And After
46365-our-schools-in-war-time-and-after.creator: Arthur D. Dean, Sc.D.
46365-our-schools-in-war-time-and-after.description: A book by Arthur D. Dean, Sc.D.. The summer of 1917 found America realizing that the war which it had entered was not going to be won by the mobilization of an army and a navy, however strong and efficient they might be. In the proclamation of Woodrow Wilson the whole nation was called upon to mobilize with a clear, succinct purpose of organizing those forces of industry, of education, of woman power, which are back of every successful struggle of a nation in peace or in war.

arxiv-2109-04076.title: The groups and nilpotent Lie rings of order p 8 p^{8} with maximal class
arxiv-2109-04076.creator: Seungjai Lee, Michael Vaughan-Lee
arxiv-2109-04076.description: Abstract We classify the nilpotent Lie rings of order p 8 p^{8} with maximal class for p ≥ 5 p\geq 5 . This also provides a classification of the groups of order p 8 p^{8} with maximal class for p ≥ 11 p\geq 11 via the Lazard correspondence.

arxiv-2208-10978.title: Q 2 Chemistry: A quantum computation platform for quantum chemistry
arxiv-2208-10978.creator: Yi Fan, Jie Liu, Xiongzhi Zeng, Zhiqian Xu, Honghui Shang, Zhenyu Li, Jinlong Yang
arxiv-2208-10978.description: Abstract Quantum computer provides new opportunities for quantum chemistry. In this article, we present a versatile, extensible, and efficient software package, named Q 2 Chemistry , for developing quantum algorithms and quantum inspired classical algorithms in the field of quantum chemistry.

arxiv-2311-11181.title: On the Interpretation of XSPEC Abundances and Emission Measures
arxiv-2311-11181.creator: D.A. Leahy, A. Foster, I. Seitenzahl
arxiv-2311-11181.description: Abstract The purpose of this work is to describe the assumptions built into the X-ray spectrum fitting software XSPEC for the calculation of element abundances and emission measure of a plasma and to describe the effects when those assumptions are not accurate. The ratio of electron density to hydrogen density in XSPEC is fixed at a constant.

arxiv-2404-18781.title: Wavelet–based tools to analyze, filter, and reconstruct transient gravitational–wave signals.
arxiv-2404-18781.creator: Andrea Virtuoso, Edoardo Milotti
arxiv-2404-18781.description: Abstract The analysis of gravitational–wave signals is one of the most challenging application areas of signal processing, because of the extreme weakness of these signals and of the great complexity of gravitational–wave detectors. Wavelet transforms are specially helpful in detecting and analyzing gravitational–wave transients and several analysis pipelines are based on these transforms, both continuous and discrete.

arxiv-2410-16388.title: Compact Binary Coalescences in Dense Gaseous Environments Can Pose as ones in Vacuum
arxiv-2410-16388.creator: Soumen Roy, Rodrigo Vicente
arxiv-2410-16388.description: Abstract The gravitational-wave events observed by the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA collaboration are attributed to compact binary coalescences happening in vacuum. However, several studies suggest that gaseous environments may play a significant role in the formation and evolution of compact binaries. Why have we not seen environmental effects in LVK signals?

arxiv-2505-07561.title: Fine-scale opposite-polarity magnetic fields in a solar plage revealed by integral field spectropolarimetry
arxiv-2505-07561.creator: G. Liu, I. Milić, J.S. Castellanos Durán, J.M. Borrero, M. van Noort, C. Kuckein
arxiv-2505-07561.description: Abstract Context. Plages are small concentrations of strong, nearly vertical magnetic fields in the solar photosphere that expand with height. A high spatial and spectral resolution that can resolve their fine structure is required to characterize them, and spectropolarimetric capabilities are needed to infer their magnetic fields. Aims.

arxiv-2507-11601.title: Making the Subdominant Dominant: Gravothermal Pile-Up of Collisional Dark Matter Around Compact Objects
arxiv-2507-11601.creator: Reza Ebadi, Erwin H. Tanin
arxiv-2507-11601.description: Abstract The dark matter may consist of multiple species that interact differently. We show that a species that is cosmologically subdominant but highly collisional can pile up and become dominant in deep gravitational wells, such as those of white dwarfs and neutron stars.

arxiv-2512-21099.title: TexAvatars: Hybrid Texel-3D Representations for Stable Rigging of Photorealistic Gaussian Head Avatars
arxiv-2512-21099.creator: Jaeseong Lee, Junyeong Ahn, Taewoong Kang, Jaegul Choo
arxiv-2512-21099.description: Abstract Constructing drivable and photorealistic 3D head avatars has become a central task in AR/XR, enabling immersive and expressive user experiences. With the emergence of high-fidelity, efficient representations such as 3D Gaussians, recent works have pushed toward ultra-detailed head avatars. Existing approaches typically fall into two categories: rule-based analytic rigging or neural network-based deformation fields.

pmc-10518311.title: Orthosteric ligand selectivity and allosteric probe dependence at Hydroxycarboxylic acid receptor HCAR2
pmc-10518311.creator: Lin Cheng, Suyue Sun, Heli Wang, Chang Zhao, Xiaowen Tian, Ying Liu, Ping Fu, Zhenhua Shao, Renjie Chai, Wei Yan
pmc-10518311.description: Hydroxycarboxylic acid receptor 2 (HCAR2), a member of Class A G-protein-coupled receptor (GPCR) family, plays a pivotal role in anti-lipolytic and anti-inflammatory effects, establishing it as a significant therapeutic target for treating dyslipidemia and inflammatory diseases. However, the mechanism underlying the signaling of HCAR2 induced by various types of ligands remains elusive.

pmc-10674529.title: Lightweight Multi-Class Support Vector Machine-Based Medical Diagnosis System with Privacy Preservation
pmc-10674529.creator: Sherif Abdelfattah, Mohamed Baza, Mohamed Mahmoud, Mostafa M Fouda, Khalid Abualsaud, Elias Yaacoub, Maazen Alsabaan, Mohsen Guizani, Alessandra Rizzardi
pmc-10674529.description: Machine learning, powered by cloud servers, has found application in medical diagnosis, enhancing the capabilities of smart healthcare services. Research literature demonstrates that the support vector machine (SVM) consistently demonstrates remarkable accuracy in medical diagnosis. Nonetheless, safeguarding patients’ health data privacy and preserving the intellectual property of diagnosis models is of paramount importance.

pmc-11463702.title: Physician-to-Physician eConsultations to Ophthalmologists at an Academic Medical Center
pmc-11463702.creator: Noha A. Sherif, Alice C. Lorch, Grayson W. Armstrong
pmc-11463702.description: PurposePhysician-to-physician electronic consultation (eConsults) are used across specialties; however, their effectiveness in ophthalmology has not been reported. This study evaluated the feasibility and diagnostic accuracy of a physician-to-physician ophthalmology eConsult program, assessed the timeliness of in-person evaluation, and characterized the clinical questions of non-ophthalmology providers.

pmc-11712695.title: Assessment of the Empact of IGC‐AD1 on Hepatic Biomarkers in Alzheimer’s Disease: Insights from a Phase 1 Trial
pmc-11712695.creator: Diego Rodriguez‐Soacha, Andres Cañon, Laura Tatiana Sánchez, Jagadeesh S Rao, Laura Delgado‐Murillo, Margarita Venegas, Maria Alejandra Tangarife, Maria Juanita Arbelaez, Evelyn Gutiérrez, Saadia Shahnawaz, Varduhi Ghazaryan, William Julio De Jesus, Claudia Grimaldi, Elliot Hong, Ram Mukunda
pmc-11712695.description: BackgroundIGC‐AD1 comprises of Tetrahydrocannabinol (“THC”) and melatonin. The two active pharmaceuticals are known for their neuroprotective properties. In this analysis we studied multiple dosing of IGC‐AD1 in Alzheimer’s (“AD”) populations vulnerable to hepatic complications. We present the impact of three different doses on hepatic functions, offering insights into dosage‐dependent safety and potential therapeutic implications.

pmc-12470730.title: Biological and Genomic Insights into Fusarium acuminatum Causing Needle Blight in Pinus tabuliformis
pmc-12470730.creator: Linin Song, Yuying Xu, Tianjin Liu, He Wang, Xinyue Wang, Changxiao Fu, Xiaoling Xie, Yakubu Saddeeq Abubakar, Abah Felix, Ruixian Yang, Xinhong Jing, Guodong Lu, Jiandong Bao, Wenyu Ye, Baoshan Chen
pmc-12470730.description: Chinese pine, Pinus tabuliformis, is one of the most important garden plants in northern China, and the planting of this species is of great significance for the improvement of the ecological environment. In this study, different fungi were isolated and purified from diseased Pinus tabuliformis samples collected in Xi’an city, Shaanxi Province.

PurposeThe readability of public-facing vaccine-related information is an important aspect of health literacy particularly regarding vaccine uptake. pmc-13137922.title: Improving the Accuracy of ED Triage Using the Australasian Triage Scale: A Closed-Loop Quality Improvement Project
pmc-13137922.creator: Mohamed Ahmed Abugibba Mohamed, Ahmed Mohammed Abdullah Abdulaziz, Mohammed Hasan Ahmed Al-Attas, Khalid Mustafa Yousif Osman, Mohammed Fadhl Salem Dahloos, Abdullah Abdulsadeq Salem Bawazir, Mustafa Hassan Ali Mohamed, Sanad Ahmed Abdulrahman Al-Mansori, Mohammed Saleh Mohammed Basleem, Mohammed Hu
pmc-13137922.description: Background and aimAccurate ED triage is essential for patient safety, timely care, and effective resource utilization. The Australasian Triage Scale (ATS) provides a standardized framework for prioritizing patients based on clinical urgency; however, variability in its application may compromise care quality.

pmc-13197289.title: Integrated molecular and metabolomic assessment of copper hydroxide nanopesticide toxicity in zebrafish
pmc-13197289.creator: Feyza Icoglu Aksakal, Cihan Gür, Turgay Şişman, Semih Özli, Onur Şenol, Özkan Aksakal
pmc-13197289.description: Copper hydroxide (Cu(OH)2) nanopesticides [Cu(OH)2 NP] are increasingly applied in agriculture, raising concerns about their potential risks to non-target aquatic organisms. In this study, we investigated the toxic effects of Cu(OH)2 NP exposure in zebrafish (Danio rerio) larvae and adults using an integrated gene expression and metabolomic approach.

pmc-13343776.creator: Idan Grossmann, Aubin Attila, Anid Hassan, Anasuya Brahmamdam, Jaimin Dudhia, William Sebastian, Stuart Campbell, Aroob Farooqi, Kamil Ahmad Kamil, Mohammad Amir Hossain, Lee Peng
pmc-13343776.description: BackgroundPneumatosis cystoides intestinalis (PCI) is a rare condition characterized by the presence of multiple gas-filled cysts within the wall of the gastrointestinal tract, leading to variable clinical presentations and diagnostic challenges. A bronchoperitoneal fistula is an exceedingly rare complication, typically resulting from downward gas tracking secondary to thoracic pathology.

pmc-13502823.title: Scoping Cognitive Screening in Inflammatory Bowel Disease
pmc-13502823.creator: Christopher W.P. Hopkins
pmc-13502823.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). bility of cognitive interrogation at the time of routine endoscopic examination raise eyebrows. The authors propose that appointments for routine colonoscopic examination may represent a feasible time to screen for cognitive impairment in IBD. The authors acknowledge that periprocedural factors, such as bowel preparation, fasting, sleep disturbance, anxiety, and situational stress, may transiently impair cognitive performance of participants undergoing endoscopy, and people with IBD are more susceptible to these effects (2,3).

pmc-13677022.title: Factors associated with outcomes after reverse total shoulder arthroplasty at midterm follow-up
pmc-13677022.creator: Lorenz Fritsch, Brendon C Mitchell, Michael Nocek, Marilee P Horan, Grant J Dornan, Trey C Rogers, Katelyn L Kirwood, Shane Corber, Peter J Millett
pmc-13677022.description: BackgroundReverse total shoulder arthroplasty has become the preferred treatment for many patients with irreparable cuff tears, osteoarthritis, and complex proximal humeral fractures. While outcomes are generally favorable, the influence of demographic and surgical factors—such as age, sex, previous surgery, and dominance of the operated arm—on post-operative results remains incompletely understood.
